meta.name: ai-search-optimization
meta.description: Optimizes for AI assistants and AI-generated answers — being retrievable, being cited, and being represented accurately when a model answers on your behalf. Use this when traffic is shifting from links to AI answers, when a brand is misrepresented or absent in AI responses, when planning content for retrieval rather than ranking, or when deciding how AI search changes an existing SEO program.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让品牌在 AI 答案中被准确呈现与引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果品牌在 AI 回答中的表现让你担忧,想主动优化被检索与引用的效果。
copy.tagline_en: Get your brand accurately cited in AI-generated answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry about how AI answers present your brand and want better visibility.

howto.what: 装上后，会按“被AI引用”的标准给优化建议：首句作答、段落自包含、事实可核查、结构可提取；标题写成问句，维护FAQ等常规页。还会提醒定期用AI查品牌描述并修正来源，用引用频次而非自然流量衡量效果。
howto.when: 当你说到流量从链接转向AI回答、品牌在AI答复中失实/缺失、要为AI检索规划内容等场景时，会触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面，让它更容易被AI引用。
say.note: Claude 会按引用标准检查并给出改写建议。

say.text: 我该优先维护公司网站的哪些页面？
say.note: 会建议侧重定价、对比、FAQ等常被检索的页面。

say.text: 用几个AI工具查一下我们品牌被描述成什么样。
say.note: 会提醒你按审计结果修正信息来源。

howto.what_en: Guides optimization for AI citation: answer first, self-contained passages, checkable facts, real structure; question headings; keep FAQ/pricing pages; audit AI brand answers; track citations, not organic clicks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when traffic shifts from links to AI answers, brands are misrepresented or missing in AI responses, or content is planned for retrieval, etc.

say_en.text: Help me make this page more likely to be cited by AI.
say_en.note: Reviews and suggests edits for citation-friendliness.

say_en.text: Which pages should I prioritize maintaining on our site?
Ask a few AI tools how they describe our brand.
say_en.note: Reminds you to fix the source based on audit.
